patthana22.16:1.1: akusalo saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi,
patthana22.16:2.1: na kusalaṃ na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na abyākataṃ na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na kusalaṃ na araṇañca na abyākataṃ na araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi. na sukhāya
